name: Drygulch Ravine
summary: Dustwind harpies hold Drygulch Ravine, where they menace nearby supply caravans. The gorge lies among eastern Durotar's rocky bluffs, reached by a cave passage from Razorwind Canyon or a perilous drop from above.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven in the Red Rocks
sections.body: In the crags east of Orgrimmar, Drygulch Ravine forms a sheltered depression and a lawless pocket of Durotar. A cramped natural tunnel from Razorwind Canyon is its only ground-level route. Dustwind harpies roost along the steep cliffs, where they nest their broods and stockpile goods stolen from Horde supply trains on the regional trails.

sections.title: A Thorn in Durotar's Side
sections.body: Dustwind harpies are the ravine's immediate danger. Their matriarchs fiercely defend clutches of eggs tucked along the high ledges. Horde scouts often send young warriors to thin the flock, recover plundered trade crates, and break the harpies' hold on the ravine.

faq.q: How do you get into Drygulch Ravine?
aliases: where is the cave to drygulch
faq.answer: You can reach the ravine by surviving a leap from the high cliffs above or by taking the small cave entrance in neighboring Razorwind Canyon.

faq.q: What creatures live in Drygulch Ravine?
faq.answer: Dustwind harpies dominate the ravine, nesting, laying eggs, and stashing stolen caravan supplies along its craggy rock shelves.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this ravine?
faq.answer: The Dustwind harpies raid Durotar's vital trade trails and hoard stolen cargo in the gorge. Authorities in Razor Hill regularly send recruits to recover provisions and thin the flock.

angles.text: Securing the ravine's roosts and recovering stolen supplies helps protect Durotar's internal trade routes from constant banditry.
As a young orc, you can prove your mettle against the ferocious harpies perched on your homeland's rocky bluffs.
